run_multi_proc_run: run a function across multiple processes with error handling and process group initialization
run_run_child_process: run a function from a child process with distributed process group setup and teardown
get_gpu_memory_map: get the current GPU memory usage in MB for all available GPUs via nvidia-smi
auto_select_gpu: auto select an available GPU based on memory usage probability and a configurable threshold
test_multi_proc_run: test the multi_proc_run function to verify it spawns and joins multiple subprocesses correctly
